_comment: Config-driven macro series list per architecture doc section 1.2. Add/remove entries here without touching schema or script code. 'units' follows FRED's own transformation params (lin = no transform, pc1 = percent change from year ago). 'lookback_days' (optional): the daily run re-fetches max(--lookback-days, lookback_days) days -- monthly/weekly/quarterly series are dated at the START of their period, published weeks later and revised, so they need ~400. A series not yet in macro_series is backfilled from 1990 automatically on its first run. Data Health freshness rules live in index.html MACRO_SERIES_INFO -- add a line there too when adding a series.
